area: arcade intensity ladders (Harvest, Shatterplane I3/I4 pattern)
summary: Standard element ladder: I1 nothing, I2 every hull at level 5 in the game's element (platform default for every non-arena card with no StartingElements table, incl. Harvest/Shatterplane), I3 team crystals of the element (your Harvest pattern, to be generalised), I4 element fauna in the cell's colour.
